sentences.text: type=fact The current RBI rule for this case is the residual UCB rule, which says that in cases other than the specified exceptions, pre-payment charges, if any, shall be as per the approved policy of a UCB. (R5)
type=fact The Home Loan Agreement’s Clause 9.3 requires the borrower to pay a pre-payment charge of 2% of the principal outstanding on foreclosure or pre-payment, in full or in part. (E2, E3)
type=fact The bank’s retail loan policy states that foreclosure charges of 2% plus GST on the principal outstanding shall be levied on all term loans pre-closed by the borrower. (E1)

type=fact On the evidence provided, the clause is not shown to conflict with the current RBI rule because the rule allows pre-payment charges if they are as per the approved UCB policy, but the evidence does not show that this policy is approved. (R5, E1)

missing.searched: searched the provided evidence for whether Example UCB’s Retail Loan Policy v3 is an approved policy under the current RBI rule, but no evidence states that it is approved.
